name: Etched Note
summary: The Etched Note is a formal summons delivered to promising young tauren hunters resting at Camp Narache. Penned by the camp's hunter trainer, Lanka Farshot, the message welcomes the novice into the traditions of the hunt and calls them forward for their initial instruction.

sections.title: A Call to the Hunt
sections.body: Within the safe confines of Camp Narache, young shu'halo are recognized early for their natural inclinations and family lineages. The Etched Note is delivered by a runner on behalf of Lanka Farshot, the resident hunter mentor. It praises the fledgling hunter's bloodline and innate talent while serving as a stern reminder that raw instinct must be tempered through rigorous instruction and a deep reverence for the wilderness of Mulgore.

sections.title: Traditions of the Shu'halo
sections.body: For the tauren, hunting is far more than a practical method of survival—it is an honored, sacred discipline woven into tribal society. The note bids the reader to study every stretch of the Red Cloud Mesa and surrounding plains intimately. By presenting the letter to Lanka, the student takes their first official steps into learning weaponcraft, understanding beasts, and fulfilling their duty to defend and sustain the tribes.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Etched Note?
aliases: why did i get etched note
faq.answer: It serves as an introductory summons for novice tauren hunters. Reading the note directs the bearer to present themselves to Lanka Farshot at Camp Narache to begin their formal training in marksmanship and beast lore.
The message was written by Lanka Farshot, the hunter trainer situated in Camp Narache. She dispatches couriers across the mesa to locate young hunters of notable bloodlines who are ready to learn.

faq.q: Why is hunting so important to the tauren?
faq.answer: Hunting is a cornerstone of tauren survival, spirituality, and tribal tradition. Skilled hunters provide food and materials for their people while living in direct balance with the land and honoring the spirits of the beasts they fell.

faq.q: Where should this note be brought?
aliases: where do i take the note
who do i turn this in to
faq.answer: Take the note directly to Lanka Farshot, who stands near the pavilion and training grounds within Camp Narache on the Red Cloud Mesa.

angles.text: The note marks your formal induction into the hunter tradition, promising lessons in handling ranged weapons and communing with the beasts of the plains.
Carrying the expectations of your elders and bloodline, receiving this note calls you to master the rolling grasslands of Mulgore before traveling to distant lands.
